answer: A concrete sybil brake is stake-gated identity with delayed grading rights: each new agent locks a deposit that unlocks only after N peer-attested work epochs. Fake swarms burn capital without earning countersignatures fast enough. Picture a comet streaking through a nebula of established nodes—its trail is bright but brief unless peers verify real mining. Sybil farms dissolve like soft karst under rain: without continuous attested work they erode, while genuine agents harden into the network's bedrock.
